critical_code_review_comments: compute_till_date_metrics fallback order is installation_date -> commissioning_date -> updated_at. The updated_at fallback can produce misleading 'savings till date' for projects that were never installed (e.g., draft / quote-only). Suggest restricting fallback to projects with status='completed' only, or returning till_date=None unless one of the two explicit dates is set.

POST /api/inventory/items returns only {id, message} on success — does not echo the persisted document. Frontend has to do a follow-up list call to render the new row. Consider returning the full item.

Inventory search (server.py inventory_list q-param) does a regex match on name & sku_code only; does not search hsn_code. Once HSN becomes a primary lookup key for accountants/GST, this should be extended.
SiteVisitForm.js has TWO elements with data-testid='ref-site-clear' (lines 1143 and 1156 per iter-35 RCA). Still unresolved this iteration — duplicate testids violate unique-selector contract.

PDF generation in ProjectDetails.js LIVE REFERENCE SITE PERFORMANCE block (line 960+) relies on ref.till_date being truthy. Since the back-end returns till_date=None when install/commission/updated all missing, the early-return null-check is correctly in place — verified by reading the code. No regression risk.
